title: The Forehead Test That Reveals Your True Personality

vo.en: Draw a letter Q on your forehead.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's index finger reaching towards his forehead in a dimly lit studio.

vo.en: Use your index finger. Trace it fast, don't think, just move your hand.

visual.description: A fast-motion montage of a vintage analog clock spinning and a person's hands typing rapidly.

vo.en: Now focus on the tail. Did you point it to your left or right?

visual.description: A compass needle spinning wildly followed by a shot of a man looking at a directional street sign.

vo.en: Stop, because this reveals a creepy truth about how your secret brain is wired.

visual.description: A futuristic blue digital animation of a human brain with glowing neural pathways.

vo.en: If it points right, you’re an authentic soul who stays true to yourself.

visual.description: A man standing alone on a vast mountain cliffside looking out at a sunrise.

vo.en: If it points left, you’re a social chameleon, a master at reading rooms.

visual.description: A macro shot of a chameleon's eye followed by a blurred time-lapse of a busy city crowd.

vo.en: You likely hide your feelings to master every single room you enter.

visual.description: An intense close-up of a man's eyes staring through a magnifying glass and hands holding playing cards.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow’s brain test and comment your direction. To start, simply
